summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper that applies rule 1 (subject triples, recursing into blank-node objects not yet a subject in the result) and rule 3 (all triples of every reifier whose rdf:subject is the node, with no type or predicate/object checks; reifier rdf:object values are not followed). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the specified counts (8, 3, 2, 0; reified A = 8; reified B = 13; incoming reification; blank-node non-expansion via reification = 4; blank-node cycle = 4; source immutability). Nothing was run, per instructions, so the expected counts are hand-derived and unverified. No commits made.
